title: Item Input Value
description: The buyer's answer to one item input on a cart or checkout line.

id.description: The `id` of the input being answered, one of the line's `item_inputs[].id`.

value.description: The answer. A string for `text`; an option's `value` for `choice`; `true` or `false` for `boolean`; a `YYYY-MM-DD` string for `date`. To leave an input unanswered, omit its entry.
